title: Saltwater Dreams | Exclusive 30A
meta_description: Saltwater Dreams is a Seagrove condo with lake views, bikes, a waterfront pool, and a short ride to the beach, shopping, and dining along 30A.
description_expanded: Welcome to Saltwater Dreams. Water views! Enjoy the beauty of the community lake from the comfort of the screened in patio. This well-appointed condo is in the private gated Seagrove Highlands community, centrally located in the heart of Seagrove along prestigious Highway 30A. Only 2-minute bike ride to the beach and walking distance to shopping and dining on 30A. What you'll love about this mid-rise condominium is the value you get being just a short distance to the sugar white sands of the Gulf shore. This 3-bedroom hideaway comes complete with all furnishings, condo decor, kitchenware, washer/dryer and bikes. The Seagrove Highlands Condominium offers a waterfront pool overlooking a tranquil pond, ample parking, and quick elevator access! Saltwater Dreams Features - 2 Minute Bike Ride to Beachwood Villas Public Beach Access. Beach chair rentals available from vendor on site. - Lake views from the screened in patio and king suite - Close to shopping and dining on 30A - only a 1-minute bike ride away - Complimentary Use of 4 Taxi Bikes, serviced regularly to keep in top shape - Community Pool overlooking large pond and dock - Outdoor grill available at the community pool - Private, gated community near everything but also quiet and relaxing - All one level! Elevator access available to condo floor - Parking for 2 vehicles on a first come, first serve basis in the parking lot - Full Kitchen, well stocked for meal prep - Dining for 6 and breakfast bar seating for 2 - Screened-in balcony with cushioned seating and café lights - Smart TV in living room plus TVs in all bedrooms - Cable and WIFI available - Laundry closet with stacked washer/dryer - At least one mid-stay clean is required for any reservation 10 days or longer and this cost is included in your reservation. Extra cleans can be scheduled for an additional fee 3 Bedrooms, 2 Baths, Sleeps 8 - King Suite - lake view, Smart TV, en suite bath with walk-in shower, soaking tub, and dual vanity sinks - Queen Guest Room - Smart TV, across the hall from a shared full bath with combination shower/tub - Bunk Room - Flat Screen TV, Sleeps 4 in two Twin over Twin Bunks, adjacent to a shared full bath with combination shower/tub
rooms_guidance: Bunk Room | two Twin over Twin Bunks
